name: Evotronics Inc
old_description: We are the trusted Provider of printed circuit board (PCB) contract manufacturing services in the Minneapolis / St. Paul area
about:
Evotronics Inc is a family-owned PCB contract manufacturing company based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Founded in 1995 by Tam Tran, the business is now led by co-owners Anh Tran and Ken Nguyen. The company began as a provider of design, manufacture, test, distribution, and repair services for electronic assemblies serving original equipment manufacturers.

The shop offers a full range of electronics assembly services, including through-hole and surface-mount assembly, custom cable assembly, electro-mechanical assembly, and final box-build with labeling and serialization. Capabilities extend to engineering support, first-article test runs, rework, and conformal coating application. The facility is climate-controlled and monitored by a surveillance system, and the company states it handles both small prototype runs and higher-volume production.

Evotronics serves OEMs across retail, consumer, industrial, medical, and defense/aerospace sectors. Customers rely on the company for prototyping, design-for-manufacturing feedback, and BOM alternative component sourcing.

The company emphasizes a no-stencil solder paste process for rapid prototyping, automated axial insertion for ammo-pack and cut-tape components, and an in-house flood box for in-line washing. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, with UL and FDA registrations, and it maintains an ESD-safe environment audited by a third party.
